zh: 标准模式下，工具操作和修改过的文件会汇总到对话中的工作卡片，展开即可查看详情。
在手机上查看工作步骤时，详情会在抽屉中打开，方便浏览完整过程。
在任务详情中展示计划步骤，更容易了解任务进展。
修复部分历史任务和待查看任务的状态对账问题，让卡片归类更准确。
在对话和任务提问中更清晰地呈现 Codex 的结构化内容。
桌面端详情面板支持调整文字大小，主目录路径也更加简洁。
改进可执行文件链接的定位、Windows 路径处理和模型选择菜单。
en: In Standard mode, tool actions and edited files are grouped into a work card in the conversation. Expand it to see the details.
Open work steps in a drawer on your phone to browse the full process.
See plan steps in task details to follow progress more easily.
Fixed reconciliation of some historical tasks and tasks needing attention, so cards appear in the right lanes.
Structured Codex content is displayed more clearly in conversations and task questions.
Adjust text size in the desktop details panel and see shorter home directory paths.
Improved how executable file links are revealed, how Windows paths are handled, and how model selection menus behave.
